name: יְהוֹצָדָק
summary: The priest, son of Seraiah, who went into exile when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by Nebuchadnezzar (1Ch 5:40–41); his father Seraiah the chief priest was put to death at Riblah (2Ki 25:18, 21). His son Joshua (Jeshua) was high priest at the return, built the altar with Zerubbabel, and was crowned in Zechariah's sign (Ezr 3:2; Hag 1:1, 12; Zec 6:11). Spelled יְהוֹצָדָק in Chronicles, Haggai and Zechariah, and יוֹצָדָק in Ezra and Nehemiah, the Aramaic of Ezr 5:2 included. The name is יְהוֹ, Yahweh's name, with the verb צָדַק: “Yahweh is righteous”, the confession of the exile: “Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he has done” (Dan 9:14), “you are righteous in all that has come upon us” (Neh 9:33).

evidence.note: “Seraiah fathered יְהוֹצָדָק, וִיהוֹצָדָק went when Yahweh exiled Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.”
Seraiah the chief priest taken by the captain of the guard, and killed at Riblah (2Ki 25:21).
“To Joshua בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָק the high priest.” Also Hag 1:12, 14.
Crowns set “on the head of Joshua בֶּן יְהוֹצָדָק the high priest”.
“Jeshua בֶּן יוֹצָדָק and his brothers the priests” build the altar.
Sons of “Jeshua בֶּן יוֹצָדָק” had married foreign women.
“כִּי צַדִּיק יַהְוֶה אֱלֹהֵינוּ in all his works which he has done.”
“וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק concerning all that has come upon us.”

note: BDB e.az.av covers both Hebrew spellings, xj.ad.ae the Aramaic יוֹצָדָק of Ezr 5:2. TIPNR keeps Jozadak@Ezr.10.18 apart from Jehozadak@1Ch.6.14, though Ezr 10:18 is “Jeshua son of Jozadak”, the same high priest's father; both keys are tagged. The verb is the third-person perfect, as in יְהוֹנָתָן; the gloss rests on the form, since scripture does not explain the name. Dan 9:14 and Neh 9:33 are cited for the same confession in other words, not as explaining the name.
